scenes.title: Beginning, Middle and End
scenes.summary: The action must be whole: a beginning that follows nothing necessarily, a middle, and an end that nothing follows; plots must not begin or end at random.

scenes.title: The Beautiful Creature
scenes.summary: Beauty lies in magnitude and order: a creature neither too small to be seen nor too large to be taken in; plots must have a length that memory can hold.

scenes.title: The Limit of Length
scenes.summary: The limit set by competitions is not the art's concern. By nature the larger is finer while it stays clear, and long enough for a change of fortune by probability or necessity.
